## Summary
Confirmed the separate Loading content… cycle in a real browser through connector/session-server routes. MEKUGI-286's live-section race is also now reproduced before the fix and passes after it.

## Details
A bounded temporary TestWebUIBrowserHydrationProbe published a >2 KiB final-response entry, hydrated it, then appended real text at entry revisions 2 and 3 while delaying each content HTTP read. Both updates hid the already-rendered tail and showed Loading content…; releasing each read restored the tail. Publishing an unrelated session-title change with the unchanged entry revision caused no new content read. This proves expected streaming revisions alone cause the cycle; it does not prove whether the original reported session also has unnecessary revisions.
The source chain is activity_native.go:122-130 (agentMessage delta appends text and replaces record), presentation/model.go:114-124 (replacement increments entry revision), sessionapi/pages.go:15-36 (oversized entry compacts to 512-byte text with automatic hydration), and Transcript.svelte:240-320,353-360 (changed revision triggers acquisition and excludes the previous hydrated rendering immediately).
No production changes for this second issue. Temporary probe captures are apple4 and apple6; I am reverting only that probe before the 286 review/commit. They can be reapplied if useful. Suggested separate issue scope: preserve readable previously hydrated streamed content while the newer revision is being acquired, retaining attachment and latest-revision admission. The probe passed in 2.54 seconds; the 286 browser suite passed in 25.49 seconds.
